# Vera Zhang

> Contemporary Chinese artist. Personal site featuring fine art paintings, bilingual writing on creativity.

Vera Zhang is a painter at heart. The site is bilingual (English and 中文); content is authored in both languages where applicable.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.verazhang.com/): 12 Instruments — a featured 12-piece painting series on musical instruments.
- [About](https://www.verazhang.com/about): Bilingual bio written as a short poem.
- [Art](https://www.verazhang.com/art): Gallery of paintings, each with a bilingual title and short description.
- [Blog](https://www.verazhang.com/blog): Bilingual writing on art, emotion, and creativity.

## Blog posts

- [Art is brain food](https://www.verazhang.com/blog/brain): Essay on how art and music feed the brain. Bilingual (English / 中文). Published 2020-04-25.
- [What is creative freedom?](https://www.verazhang.com/blog/creative-freedom): Five principles for creative freedom — knowing the boundary, building your voice, mastering skills, cross-field inspiration, and acting. Bilingual (English / 中文). Published 2019-05-29.
- [Genesis, a computing model](https://www.verazhang.com/blog/genesis): A toy computing model where 1+1 ≠ 2, with a Python implementation. Published 2018-11-06.
- [开篇寄语 (Opening)](https://www.verazhang.com/blog/opening): First blog post, in Chinese — on perfectionism and just starting. Published 2018-01-01.
